## Quality rescue priorities
1. Visibly upgrade the **actual hero F1 car** using the V2 modelling rig; preserve true skid/physics interfaces and rolling wheels, correct chassis-to-track clearance, optional interior/driver only when visibly helpful. No toy-like silhouette, flat sheet metals, double chassis, hovering wheels, spinning rear wings.
2. **Spectacular first-second real-contact sparks** from authentic signed-gap events only, readable metal/road macro, intermittent realistic world-space streaks; no exhaust flames or decorative kit emitters.
3. **Dynamic coherent camera storytelling:** visible car large in 9:16, real forward track motion, no long static lateral views, no extreme macro body occlusion, no empty asphalt payoff, gentle readable underbody geometry explanation.
4. **Premium illuminated night raceway:** textured and slightly reflective if desired but NEVER duplicated road surface different from physics; clear deep colour, readable hero silhouette, convincing shadows/highlights/spark lighting, no washed-out grey/fog/grain/blur/black crush.
